description: This file contains utility functions for handling input validation, including checks for printable characters, IP addresses, URLs, MAC addresses, port numbers, IDs, time ranges, days, SSID names, and string validity. It also initializes a CSRF protection library and manages locale settings for a web UI.

methods.name: printableCharacters
methods.description: Checks if the input string contains only printable ASCII characters within specified range or all printable characters if range is not specified.

methods.name: noSpace
methods.description: Checks if the input contains at least one non-whitespace character.

methods.name: validIPAddr
methods.description: Validates whether the provided IP address is valid for IPv4 or IPv6.

methods.name: validLink
methods.description: Validates whether the provided link conforms to the URL pattern.

methods.name: validMAC
methods.description: Validates whether the provided MAC address is valid and not a broadcast address.

methods.name: validPort
methods.description: Validates whether the port number is between 1 and 65535.

methods.name: validId
methods.description: Checks if the ID is in the range 1-256.

methods.name: validId_PC
methods.description: Checks if the parental control ID (which can be ranges like '10_12') is within valid range.

methods.name: isValInArray
methods.description: Checks if a value exists within an array.

methods.name: isValInRange
methods.description: Checks if a given value falls within a specified min and max range.

methods.name: validURL
methods.description: Performs comprehensive validation of a URL using regex patterns.

methods.name: validTime
methods.description: Validates that start and end times are within range and logically ordered.

methods.name: validDays
methods.description: Checks if the provided days are within the valid set of weekday abbreviations.

methods.name: valid_ssid_name
methods.description: Validates SSID names based on length, reserved prefixes, and prohibited substrings.

methods.name: is_allowed_string
methods.description: Checks if a string contains any invalid characters like <, >, &, ', ", |.

methods.name: remove_special_char
methods.description: Checks if a string does not contain special characters; the function name suggests removal, but it only validates via regex.
